WarPointsRewardDefinition.Name: BattleWon
WarPointsRewardDefinition.Formula: (1.5 * Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, VictoryLevel)) + Clamp01(Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, MyHeroesCount)) + Clamp01(Property(EncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, EnemyHeroesKilledCount))

WarPointsRewardDefinition.Name: BattleLost
WarPointsRewardDefinition.Formula: ((1.5 * Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, VictoryLevel)) + Clamp01(Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, MyHeroesCount)) + Clamp01(Property(EnemyEncounterGroup, @ClassGroup, EnemyHeroesKilledCount)) - 1.5) * -0.1
